limitations: Independent semantic and causal review is pending; no row or issuance is accepted yet.

Releases r1 through r5 remain rejected transition history: r2 corrected fifteen typed and causal defects, r3 corrected those findings but left four supervisor and time defects, r4 corrected those and exposed CLAIM-031, CLAIM-035, and CLAIM-041 closure defects, and r5 retained the sound CLAIM-035 correction while leaving residual CLAIM-031 and CLAIM-041 defects addressed only by this r6 authoring transaction.
The fixtures are small design-derived discriminators, not performance baselines or claims about current production behavior.
Later packets must execute these expectations through the real Rust daemon, cpgd.v2 client, installed adapter, and FastMCP client before production certification.
Source digests must be refreshed and the review repeated if any source-provenance byte changes before freeze.
